title: 第1章 超凡世界第2章 荣耀级天空霸龙兽
slug: 神话纪元开局三寸石猴基因

头疼。
季知行用了半节课时间，才勉强从翻涌混乱的记忆中理清头绪，确定了一件事。
自己转世投胎了，而且，这是一个超凡世界。
以前的他，只获得了一点前世记忆，现在终于想起了前世的一切。
“记忆太乱了。”季知行心中暗叹，“不过至少弄明白了，这里是基因修行者的世界。”
他将头转向窗外。
操场上，两个其他班级的同学，正在老师的指点下，激烈交手。
一个瘦高男生抬起右手，七八根生着倒刺的蓝色蔓藤纠缠成一条长鞭，向对面抽去，带着破空声。
另一个寸头男生喉咙里发出低吼，脚下一蹬，像只大猫似的斜刺里跃起，瞬间到了六七米外。
可他刚一落地，地面就凝聚出蓝色冰霜，让他身形一晃，就在这微小的迟滞间，那道藤蔓长鞭已如影随形，再度抽至！
“齐行洲的蓝霜寒冰藤基因是真强啊，咱们学校融合二阶基因的基因修行者，怕是没有人是他对手。”
“石向阳的三眼虎猫基因也不弱，可惜被克制了。”
前排两人一边趴着窗户向外看着，一边啧啧感叹。
季知行听着他们的话，脑子里那些刚刚融合的记忆碎片慢慢拼凑完整。
这个世界的所有人，都有几率开启基因窍，融合对应等级的基因，获得特殊的基因能力。
操场上的齐行洲，就在两年前，开启了二阶基因窍，融合了与自己契合度比较高的二阶蓝霜寒冰藤基因。
“明天咱们就要去选择基因了，不知道我与哪种基因的契合度高一些。”
前桌的罗永光眼中流露期待。
“没有用，咱俩觉醒的都是一阶基因窍，只能融合一阶基因，想要有所成就太难了。”

头发半秃，在右耳侧裁剪出一头犟驴的张浩成转头看向季知行：“现在班里这些人，只有季知行和那两个觉醒二阶基因窍的，或许能追上齐行洲。”
“我倒是觉得，相比于初始基因等级，与基因的契合度高低也同样重要。”季知行收回望向窗外的目光。
“没错。”罗永光也点点头，“书上和老师都说了，如果与基因的契合度高，低等级基因，也能进化成高等级基因。”
“基因进化？呵呵。”
张浩成摇摇头，不屑道：“这东西咱们还是别想了，那么多低等级基因，最终有几个能进化到高等级？”
季知行再次望向窗外，没有接这个话题。
两千多年前，蓝星和他前世差不多，也是科技世界。
直至某一天，天地骤变。
无数或大或小的异空间如同泡沫般融入蓝星，带来狂暴的能量潮汐和规则扰动。
蓝星本土的动植物在能量浸润下开始疯狂变异，无数闻所未闻的新物种凭空诞生。
而人类也在那次剧变中，获得了开启基因窍和融合基因的能力。
两千年过去，强大的基因修行者，伟力已近乎神话传说。
譬如他们夏国，就有强者融合了覆海蛟龙基因，蛟威浩荡，翻江覆海。
西方也有神圣人物融合天使基因，圣光普照，净化一切。
强大的基因修行者不仅地位尊崇，也拥有远超常人的漫长寿命。
时至今日，蓝星上依旧存在着一些自两千年前那场剧变中存活下来的古老人物，每一位，都拥有移山填海般的恐怖实力。
“明天就要选择基因了，到时我要怎么办？”
季知行心绪翻腾。
这样一个波澜壮阔，个人伟力归于自身的世界，正是他曾经梦想中的图景。
成为基因修行者，踏上超凡之路，他自然无比渴望。

可是……
他的意识沉入体内。
与绝大多数人都不同。
在他的感知视野中，他的体内存在着两个基因窍。

Headache.
It took Ji Zhixing half of the class to sort out his chaotic memories and determine one thing.
I have been reincarnated, and this is an extraordinary world.
In the past, he only gained a little memory of his past life, but now he finally remembered everything about his past life.
"The memory is too messy." Ji Zhixing sighed inwardly, "But at least I understand that this is the world of genetic practitioners."
He turned his head toward the window.
On the playground, two students from other classes were fighting fiercely under the guidance of the teacher.
A tall and thin boy raised his right hand, and seven or eight blue vines with barbs were entangled into a long whip and whipped towards the opposite side with a sound of breaking through the air.
Another short-haired boy let out a low growl in his throat, kicked his feet, and jumped up like a big cat, reaching six or seven meters away in an instant.
But as soon as he landed, blue ice condensed on the ground, causing him to sway. During this slight delay, the long vine whip followed him like a shadow and struck again!
"Qi Xingzhou's Blue Frost Ice Vine gene is really strong. Among the gene practitioners in our school who have integrated the second-level gene, I'm afraid no one can match him."
"Shi Xiangyang's three-eyed tiger cat gene is not weak either, but it is a pity that it has been restrained."
The two people in the front row were leaning against the window and looking out, sighing.
As Ji Zhixing listened to their words, the newly merged memory fragments in his mind slowly pieced together.
Everyone in this world has a chance to open a genetic aperture, fuse genes of the corresponding level, and gain special genetic abilities.
Qi Xingzhou on the playground opened the second-level gene aperture just two years ago and integrated the second-level blue frost and ice vine gene that is more suitable for him.
"Tomorrow we are going to select genes. I don't know which gene I am more compatible with."
Luo Yongguang, who was at the front desk, had expectations in his eyes.
"It's useless. Both of us have awakened first-order gene apertures. We can only fuse first-order genes. It's too difficult to achieve anything."
Zhang Haocheng, who had half-bald hair and a donkey cut out from the side of his right ear, turned to look at Ji Zhixing: "Now among the people in the class, only Ji Zhixing and the two who have awakened the second-order gene aperture may be able to catch up with Qi Xingzhou."
"I think that compared to the initial genetic level, the degree of compatibility with genes is equally important." Ji Zhixing retracted his gaze from the window.
"That's right." Luo Yongguang also nodded, "Both the book and the teacher said that if the compatibility with genes is high, low-level genes can also evolve into high-level genes."
"Genetic evolution? Haha."
Zhang Haocheng shook his head and said disdainfully: "We'd better not think about this thing. With so many low-level genes, how many will eventually evolve to high-level?"
Ji Zhixing looked out the window again and did not answer the topic.
More than two thousand years ago, Blue Star was similar to his previous life, also in a technological world.
Until one day, the world suddenly changed.
Countless different spaces, large or small, merge into the Blue Star like bubbles, bringing violent energy tides and rule disturbances.
The native flora and fauna of Blue Star began to mutate crazily due to the infiltration of energy, and countless unheard of new species were born out of thin air.
Humanity also gained the ability to open genetic apertures and fuse genes during that drastic change.
Two thousand years have passed, and the power of powerful genetic cultivators has become almost mythical.
For example, in their Xia Kingdom, there are strong men who have integrated the genes of the sea-shaking dragon. The dragon is so powerful that it can overturn rivers and seas.
There are also sacred figures in the West who are fused with angel genes, and the holy light shines and purifies everything.
Powerful gene practitioners not only have a respected status, but also have a lifespan far longer than ordinary people.
To this day, there are still some ancient characters on Blue Star who survived the drastic change two thousand years ago, and each one of them has terrifying power that can move mountains and reclaim seas.
"The genes will be selected tomorrow. What will I do then?"
Ji Zhixing's mind was churning.
Such a magnificent and personal powerThe world that belongs to him is exactly the picture he once dreamed of.
He is naturally eager to become a genetic practitioner and embark on the extraordinary path.
But...
His consciousness sank into his body.
Different from most people.
In his sensory field of vision, there are two genetic orifices in his body.
